records.sql: SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code, REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'incident=([0-9]+)',1,1,'i',1) AS incident_id FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND MESSAGE_LEVEL=1 ORDER BY ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP DESC, RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.PROBLEM_KEY AS problem_key, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID=i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID=i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') GROUP BY p.PROBLEM_KEY ORDER BY p.PROBLEM_KEY

SELECT code FROM (SELECT code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank FROM (SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-[0-9]{1,5}([^0-9]|$)')) WHERE code <> 'ORA-00000' GROUP BY code) WHERE frequency_rank=1 ORDER BY code

SELECT DISTINCT REPLACE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'job ([^[:space:]]+)',1,1,'i',1),'"','') AS job_name, REGEXP_SUBSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'constraint [(]([^)]*)[)]',1,1,'i',1) AS constraint_name FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-05 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND INSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'ORA-12012')>0 AND INSTR(MESSAGE_TEXT,'ORA-02292')>0 ORDER BY job_name, constraint_name

SELECT p.PROBLEM_KEY AS problem_key, COUNT(*) AS incident_count FROM V$DIAG_INCIDENT i JOIN V$DIAG_PROBLEM p ON p.PROBLEM_ID=i.PROBLEM_ID AND p.CON_ID=i.CON_ID WHERE i.CREATE_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND i.CREATE_TIME < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') GROUP BY p.PROBLEM_KEY ORDER BY p.PROBLEM_KEY

SELECT code FROM (SELECT code, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS frequency_rank FROM (SELECT 'ORA-' || LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-([0-9]{1,5})([^0-9]|$)',1,1,'c',1),5,'0') AS code FROM V$DIAG_ALERT_EXT WHERE ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-06 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND ORIGINATING_TIMESTAMP < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-11-04 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(MESSAGE_TEXT),'ORA-[0-9]{1,5}([^0-9]|$)')) WHERE code <> 'ORA-00000' GROUP BY code) WHERE frequency_rank=1 ORDER BY code
